title: Setup → Apps: the Set-default star on the current default app is disabled with no reason (nothing on hover, on focus or in the accessible description)
body:
qa#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibw6yXcLi9aRRBpPT4W

QA-source: #33096 · ux-conventions.disabled-control-reason · observed beside the clauses

**Found:** QA run of `touched:ee9ad834` at objectstack main `8e3d4a54` (18.4.0 round 2, part B, browser slice), during the off-clause probe. Seen on two fresh loads.

## Repro
1. Fresh showcase boot, admin.
2. `POST /api/v1/packages {manifest:{id:'com.qa.x', …}}`.
3. `PUT /api/v1/meta/app/x_app?package=com.qa.x` with `{name, label:'X App', active:true, isDefault:true, navigation:[…]}`.
4. Open `/_console/apps/setup/system/apps`.
5. The X App card's star button (aria-label "Set X App as default") is `disabled`:
   - its title is only "Set as default", which is its name and not the reason;
   - it has no aria-describedby;
   - it is not in the tab order;
   - no tooltip shows on hover or focus.

**Expected (ux-conventions.disabled-control-reason):** a reason such as "Already the default app", shown on hover and focus and given as the accessible description. Elsewhere the console uses a focusable wrapper with aria-describedby for this.

## Mechanism
`ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/AppManagementPage.tsx`, the Star Button (around L630–640): `disabled={processing || isDefault}`, with no reason wrapper.
